metadata.purpose: Closeout receipt for the first systematic PCA formal-position mining batch
scope: 2008 Overture 9 minority report concerning a study committee on women in diaconal ministry
2008 Review of Presbytery Records minority report concerning women reading Scripture or exhorting in public worship
2009 Overture 10 minority report concerning a study committee or pastoral letter on women's roles in the church

rules: Published signatures, concurrences, dissents, protests, and individually recorded votes are person-level evidence only when the source names the individual.
Aggregate committee or General Assembly outcomes remain event-level evidence and are not imputed to unnamed individuals.
Study-committee service is distinct from assent to every proposition in a report.
Absence from a minority list is not evidence that a person voted with the majority.
Printed names and office markers are preserved.
The Mike McLaughlin / Michael McLaughlin equivalence is a reviewed source-specific identity resolution, not a general nickname matching rule.
